prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: six original reference-informed Codec character portraits for the Peace Walker era of a Metal Gear fan game.
Create one LANDSCAPE1536x1024 sheet, EXACTLY THREE columns and TWO rows of six equal SQUARE portraits512x512. Grid is invisible: no gutters, no colored guide lines and no text. Each portrait is independently framed in its equal cell, centered head and shoulders with the entire bald head visible and collar/upper suspenders visible. Same face, age, head size, outfit and muted olive-brown studio backdrop in all six. No body crossing cell boundaries.
Subject: HOT COLDMAN from Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker1974. Faithfully based on his official Konami character render: older white man, completely bald head, stern thin angular face, pronounced cheekbones, gray eyebrows, no beard, no glasses. Dark gray buttoned shirt, slim black necktie and black suspenders; tiny red detail at the chest pocket. No coat, cap, armor or weapon.
Style: realistic hand-painted digital character illustration, detailed skin pores and age lines, textured subdued olive-brown background, cinematic restrained shadows and warm desaturated military palette. Match a polished serious Codec portrait collection, not a photograph of an actor, not anime and not pixel art. Original drawing, not copied official render.
Six expressions in strict row-major order: TOP LEFT neutral composed expression; TOP MIDDLE serious narrowed eyes and firmer jaw; TOP RIGHT warning, brows raised, mouth slightly open mid-alert; BOTTOM LEFT calm, eyes softer and mouth relaxed; BOTTOM MIDDLE humor, small dry wry smile without exaggerated comedy; BOTTOM RIGHT glitch, same recognizable face and outfit with only a subtle faint horizontal olive-gray digital interference band, no broken anatomy.
All eyes look toward camera or slight right; keep camera level and portrait framing consistent. Never add text, labels, captions, numbers, icons, logos, watermarks, UI, badges with readable text, cigarettes or extra people. Preserve identity across all six panels. Reference visually inspected: https://www.konami.com/mg/s/img/history/chara_pw/chara_10.png
referenceReview: Official Konami 1974 full-body character render visually inspected in a browser before generation. Original fan-made side-view adaptation, not an extracted official model or a claim of perfect 1:1 reproduction.
